BOUNDARY.what_this_is: A bounded map of the evidence domains the repair Product model reasons WITHIN — the six headline diagnostic areas as named aspects, each tied to the real 25 audit sections it observes. It gives grounding (D2) a stable handle: every cited observation belongs to exactly one named aspect.
BOUNDARY.what_this_is_NOT: This is NOT a CyberPeer Being Nature Layer. It confers no identity, no persistent experiential memory, no Self-Organizing Locus of Intent, and no illumination/formation-of-Being. It is a Product task-scoping device only.
BOUNDARY.cross_boundary_rule: A CyberPeer with a DataQuad has its own, separate Nature Layer (a Being concept). Nothing here is inferred to authorize Product Gates, Canon-education, or controls over a CyberPeer or its DataQuad (AEGIS Fourfold Doctrine §V).

aspects.name: Storage & disk health
aspects.definition: Free space, drive health, and reclaimable clutter.

aspects.name: Drivers & hardware
aspects.definition: Installed drivers, device errors, and hardware inventory/health.

aspects.name: Security
aspects.definition: Protection posture, Windows activation, and account exposure.

aspects.name: Performance
aspects.definition: CPU, memory, startup load, services, power, and visual-effect settings.

aspects.name: System integrity
aspects.definition: OS baseline, crash history, and repair of core system/component/update state.

coverage_invariant: The six aspects' observable_indicators partition all 25 audit sections exactly once; their related_actions partition all 26 envelope actions exactly once (security is observational, no repair action).
exclusions_global: No aspect implies a model-held belief, feeling, memory, or intent.
The model relates SUPPLIED observations to aspects; it does not sense, decide, or run the inspection (deterministic app code).
Aspects are not virtues, not IRG scores, and not a resonance/illumination field.
